messages:
sara: Heads-up — bring-up of rime-v0.9 (Q5 experimental) shows a reproducible drop on some multilang evals. en->ja BLEU down, and Arabic outputs have stray bidi/ZWJ markers before punctuation. Repro and quick logs below. :eyes:

min-jun: Thanks. can you share the numbers and a minimal repro?

sara: Quick numbers: baseline (rime-v0.8-fp16) en->ja BLEU=31.2 chrF=0.58, rime-v0.9-q5 BLEU=26.9 chrF=0.50. ar->en BLEU dropped ~3.6. Example: U+200F inserted before "," and "." in several Arabic outputs.

akiko: oof. can you paste the curl for a minimal repro?

sara: Sure — minimal repro we used:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rime-v0.9-q5","task":"translate","src":"ar","tgt":"en","input":"المشروع تأخر، نحتاج خطة جديدة."}'
```

min-jun: I ran that locally against the q5 binary and saw the bidi mark before the comma. Also tried en->ja and got broken token splits around kana-kanji boundaries.

sara: I dumped tokenization for the ja sample — rime-v0.8 token map: [...,'漢','字','、','です'] vs rime-v0.9-q5: ['漢字','','、','です'] (note: weird control inserted).

akiko: hypothesis: quant pipeline altered pre-token normalizer (NFC/NFKC) or a stray byte inserted during serializer->tokenmap step. That would explain both Arabic diacritics/bidi and merged kanji-kana splits.

ci-bot: nightly-eval: rime-v0.9-q5 failed multilang-smoke (regression +4.2 BLEU delta on checkpoint). Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/3770012345

min-jun: I checked model metadata: tokenizer_normalizer: "auto" in v0.9. In runtime that resolved to NFKD for our test environment. v0.8 had explicit "NFC". Changing to NFC locally restores previous token splits and pushes en->ja BLEU back near 30.9. Arabic punctuation also cleans up.

sara: Good catch. action items: 1) pin tokenizer_normalizer to "NFC" in rime-v0.9 model metadata; 2) re-run full multilingual evals and nightly smoke; 3) block auto-routing of rime-v0.9 to quant-hosted-int-path until confirmed. I'll open a PR for (1).

min-jun: I will re-run the int kernel smoke and the quantized path regressions today (ETA EOD).

akiko: Add a unit test to the eval harness that checks for unexpected bidi markers (U+200E/U+200F) near punctuation and a small kanji-kana split test. This should catch regressions earlier.

sara: +1 — also file a short oncall note so ops won't roll rime-v0.9 to live traffic.

ops-bot: routing-hold tag added to model rime-v0.9 by ops-bot (reason: multilang tokenization regression).

min-jun: re-run started: small smoke to finish in ~20m.

sara: Thanks. I will post the PR and attach the failing sample pairs. Will follow up once CI completes. :thumbsup:
